name: Nikos Anagnostou
review: Honestly I went into the workshop thinking I already knew our market. Two days later I was rewriting our pricing sheet on the train home. What stuck with me wasn't the slides, it was Apollo pushing back on why we were scared to raise prices in the first place. 27 years in the business and nobody had ever asked me that directly.

name: Sabine Hoffmann
review: Very structured, very practical, no fluff. We got a repeatable process for entering the Austrian market that my team could actually use the following Monday, not just a nice story.

name: Tomasz Wiśniewski
review: What I found most useful was honestly the belief part more than the tactics. Our whole regional team walked in thinking expansion into Romania was too risky and left the session actually arguing about which city to launch in first. The GYA team also stayed an extra hour after to go through our actual numbers with us, which nobody expected.

name: Youssef Al Mansoori
review: I have sat through many consultants over the years, most of them talk in circles. Apollo was direct, sometimes too direct for some of the older people in the room, but that is exactly what we needed. The framework on reframing what our team believed was possible in new markets, that alone changed how we planned our Saudi entry.

name: Ngozi Eze
review: The scaling operations module was the one that hit hardest for us. We had been doing things the same way for 8 years because it worked when we were smaller. Apollo's team showed us where that same process was actually costing us. Also appreciated that they followed up by email after with a summary, a lot of trainers just disappear once the invoice is paid.

name: Eleni Konstantinou
review: What stayed with me was the part about how we talk to our own staff, not just customers. We changed our onboarding process within two weeks of the session and turnover already looks better this quarter.

name: Yannis Michailidis
review: I run a small supply business, third generation, and I was sure this training would be for bigger companies than mine. It wasn't. The pricing conversation alone paid for the whole thing twice over.

name: Katerina Papageorgiou
review: Good energy, practical exercises, not just theory. My favorite part was rebuilding our messaging around what customers actually care about instead of what we assumed they cared about.

name: Christos Antoniou
review: At my age I did not expect to change how I think about the business, but here we are. Apollo has a way of asking one simple question that unravels years of assumptions.

name: Foteini Karagianni
review: The session on team buy-in was the one my colleagues still bring up in meetings. We finally have language for conversations we were avoiding for months.

name: Vasilis Stavridis

name: Maria Ioannidou

name: Petros Vlachos
